usageNotes: Permanently removes a cluster-wide PCI hardware mapping by its config ID. Before deleting, ensure no VMs or containers reference the mapping — Proxmox does not block deletion even if the mapping is in use, which will cause affected guests to fail at next start. Requires the `Mapping.Modify` privilege on `/mapping/pci`.

examples.summary: Delete a GPU PCI mapping named 'gpu-quadro'

destructiveReason: Permanently deletes the named PCI hardware mapping from the cluster; any VM or LXC configuration referencing this mapping by ID will fail to start until the reference is removed or the mapping is recreated.
tips: List existing mappings first with get_cluster_mapping_pci to confirm the correct ID before deleting.
Check VM configs for references to this mapping ID (e.g., via grep on /etc/pve/qemu-server/) before removal.
Deletion is immediate and cluster-wide — there is no soft-delete or recycle bin.
